lettering.text: The Ocean of Milk gives a pearl necklace and unfading garments. Ornaments shine at Devī's crown, ears, wrists, arms, ankles and fingers without an explicit donor assigned here. Viśvakarman gives axe, other weapons and impenetrable armor; the Ocean gives lotuses; Himavat gives jewels and the lion.
